title: Finite-field descent of a supplied semisimple geometric decomposition
statement: Let $k_0$ be a finite field and $\ell$ an invertible prime. Let $X/k_0$ be a finite-type scheme with irreducible geometric fiber. Let $V$ be an irreducible lisse source Weil sheaf [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex, def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves] and suppose a finite decomposition $\bar V\simeq\bigoplus_{i<N}T_i$ into irreducible geometric local systems is supplied. There are a finite extension $k_1/k_0$, an integer $r>0$ with $\#k_1=(\#k_0)^r$, an actual cartesian model $C=X\times_{k_0}k_1$ with projection $c:C\to X$ [def-pc-base-change], and finitely many geometrically irreducible source Weil sheaves $S_a$ [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible] such that $R(V)\simeq\bigoplus_aS_a$, where $R$ is exactly the explicitly constructed source constant-field restriction [def-zl-source-constant-field-restriction]. For every finite point $t$ of $C$ and any $a,b$, there is a finite point $t\prime$ with $c(t\prime)=c(t)$, $q_{t\prime}=q_t$, and an equivalence of Frobenius modules $(S_b)_t\simeq(S_a)_{t\prime}$. This statement neither constructs semisimplicity nor asserts any comparison with Frobenius at a point of $X$.

proof.text: Apply lem-zl-geometric-power-orbit to the supplied semisimple geometric decomposition. This gives a positive power r, irreducible power-return summands W, a power-equivariant biproduct isomorphism v, and original-return transports between all pairs of embedded summands.

Apply lem-zl-finite-constant-extension-exists, the already proved source finite-field extension construction exists_intermediateField_natCard_eq_pow to choose k1 of cardinality (card k0)^r inside the algebraic closure. Form the actual pullback C of X along Spec k1 to Spec k0. Via its canonical geometric-fiber isomorphism transport each W to a source Weil sheaf S. Its carrier is pushforward along an isomorphism; the inverse equivalence transports each lisse subobject back, proving geometric irreducibility. Transport v by mapOfNatIso, use preservation of finite biproducts, and lift the resulting isomorphism through the full constructible subcategory. This constructs the requested source restriction decomposition.

For t,a,b choose the original-return geometric isomorphism from the orbit result. The inclusions of W_a,W_b into the power of V are the biproduct inclusions composed with v inverse, hence are monic. Apply lem-zl-geometric-power-orbit-stalk to these two monomorphisms. The two source Weil objects are definitionally the transported W_a,W_b, so it gives t prime, the equality over X, the residue-cardinality equality, and the Frobenius-module equivalence.

proof_origin.place: Geometric-socle and finite constant-extension argument, with the power-return and pairwise stalk steps isolated and the cartesian transport constructed in Lean by K6.

theorem exists_semisimple_frobenius_orbit_descent
    {k₀ : Type u} [Field k₀] [Finite k₀] {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime]
    [Fact (ringChar k₀ ≠ l)] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [IrreducibleSpace (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber]
    (V : WeilSheaf k₀ l X) (hV : V.IsIrreducibleLisse)
    (N : ℕ) (T : Fin N → AdicSheaf l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber)
    (hT : ∀ i, IsIrreducibleAdicLocalSystem (T i)) (vT : V.obj.carrier ≅ ⨁ T) :
    ∃ (k₁ : Type u) (_ : Field k₁) (_ : Finite k₁) (_ : Algebra k₀ k₁)
      (_ : Algebra.IsAlgebraic k₀ k₁) (_ : Fact (ringChar k₁ ≠ l))
      (r : ℕ) (_ : 0 < r) (hr : Nat.card k₁ = Nat.card k₀ ^ r)
      (C : Scheme.{u}) (_ : C.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁))) (c : C ⟶ X)
      (hc : IsPullback c (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)) (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k₀ k₁))))
      (n : ℕ) (S : Fin n → WeilSheaf k₁ l C),
      Nonempty ((constantFieldRestrictionOfSquare hc r hr).obj V ≅ ⨁ S) ∧
      (∀ a, (S a).IsGeometricallyIrreducible) ∧
      ∀ (t : C.finitePoints) (a b : Fin n), ∃ t' : C.finitePoints,
        c t'.1 = c t.1 ∧
        (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)).residueCard t'.1 =
          (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)).residueCard t.1 ∧
        Nonempty (((S b).stalk t).Equiv ((S a).stalk t'))
